title: JobSSS portable application packet
description: Offline portable packet: identity plus portable relative component paths, linked answers, and checklist. Incomplete packets are valid with readiness 'incomplete'. Never carries send/submit/apply attestation. Hash rule: contentHash is lowercase SHA-256 of the stable key-ordered serialization of format/jobId/revision/components/asks/answers/checklist.

revision.description: Packet/job revision for the portable format, not MCP authority.

components.description: Portable posix-style relative paths only (no leading /, no ..); null means missing.

answers.description: Every answer must link to a real ask id; missing questions stay missing, never fabricated.
